subtitle: This is a demo report for a fictional furniture store. Every problem is shown with a screenshot and exactly where to find it.

issues.title: Customers cannot pay online
issues.say: When a customer tries to buy, the checkout page says "This store can't accept payments right now." The order cannot be completed.
issues.where:
Open any product → click Add to Cart → click Checkout → scroll down to Payment
Example: oaklinehome.example/products/linden-sofa

visuals.caption: The payment block offers no payment method.

issues.why: Every customer who tries to buy online leaves without paying. Money spent on ads is wasted.
issues.fix: Set up online payments, including instalments, and complete the store's official policy pages.

issues.title: Product pages show a clothing shop's policies
issues.say: Every product page says the store sells "clothing items" and accepts returns within 30 days. The store sells made-to-order furniture with no returns.
issues.where: Open any product → scroll below Add to Cart → read Shipping and Returns and Return Policies

visuals.caption: The yellow words are copied from the theme's demo store.

issues.why: Buyers see clothing text on a $1,890 sofa and stop trusting the store.
issues.fix: Replace the text on every product page with the real delivery, warranty and return terms.

issues.title: Fake "people viewing" and "only 10 left"
issues.where_short: Every product page, near the price
issues.say: A random visitor count and a fake stock warning appear on furniture that is made to order. The delivery box also promises returns.
issues.where: Open any product and look under the price and above Add to Cart. Refresh: the number changes.
issues.why: Shoppers notice fake numbers and stop trusting the brand.
issues.fix: Remove both and show real reasons to buy: warranty, crafting time, local delivery.

issues.title: Chat button covers "Add to Cart" on phones
issues.say: On phones, the green chat button sits on top of the Add to Cart button and the price box is cut off.
issues.where: On a phone, open any product and scroll down until the bottom bar appears.

visuals.note: 1. Chat button on top of Add to Cart. 2. Button text cut. 3. Price box cut off.

issues.why: Customers tap chat by mistake instead of buying.
issues.fix: Move the chat button and fix the bottom bar.

more.lead: These are missing today. Each one is common on furniture sites that sell well.

items.do: Bring Google reviews onto the website, with stars on every product.
A clear size table on every product.
Proper titles and descriptions for every page.

plan.title: A selling website in 30 days
plan.lead: Week 1 stops the loss. Weeks 2–4 bring more sales.

closing.title: Start with Week 1
closing.text: The urgent problems can be fixed in the first week, so customers can buy again straight away.

method: How we checked: every page on laptop and mobile, plus an automatic scan of all product pages. Checkout was tested up to the payment step without placing an order.

back.text: The urgent problems can be fixed in the first week. Let's go through this report together.
